observations.code_quote: 1. Once you have cloned the repo and installed OrbStack, install Flox. On a PostHog-managed Mac, open Fleet Desktop > My device > Self-service and select Flox. Fleet supplies the approved version and upgrades older installations.

observations.code_quote: Use Flox 1.18.2 or newer. To upgrade an existing Homebrew installation, run `brew update && brew upgrade flox`. For other installation methods, follow the [Flox upgrade instructions](https://flox.dev/docs/install-flox/install). Check the installed version with `flox --version`.
observations.behavior: Specifies minimum CLI version requirements and provides commands to check and upgrade Flox independently of repository activation.
